if: income or expense arises in the CURRENT period
it arises as a result of an ERROR OR OMISSION in the preparation of the financial statements of one or more PRIOR periods
then: it IS a prior period item, and its nature and amount MUST be separately disclosed in the statement of profit and loss so that its impact on the current profit or loss can be perceived
note: AS 5 para 17 names what counts as an error: mathematical mistakes, mistakes in applying accounting policies, misinterpretation of facts, or oversight. The test is the CAUSE, not the age of the item — relating to a prior period is not sufficient.
